operations.title: Equivariant radical repair has a first-cohomology obstruction
operations.statement: For a symmetry group Gamma acting on the repair torsor with translation module A=H^0(Hom(C(G),R)), symmetry displacement defines [b] in H^1(Gamma,A). An equivariant repair exists iff [b]=0; fixed repairs form an A^Gamma-torsor.

operations.title: Integral C2 repair torsor has no natural point
operations.procedure: Let C2 act on repair torsor Z by sigma(m)=1-m, with sign action on the translation module.
operations.outcome: b(sigma)=1 represents the nonzero class in H^1(C2,Z_sign)=Z/2; no integer fixed point exists, while 1/2 appears after inverting two.
operations.falsifier: This falsifies deriving automorphism-natural repair from mere repair existence.
